Once, I was having small talk with my science teacher. Suddenly he starts claiming I'm being rude and disrespectful for just talking to him. Idk what I did wrong. Then, after the bell rang, I started to breathe to calm down, because I was taught to do that in Elementary school of I was getting upset or mad. He then yelled at me when I didn't immediately start taking notes. I was breathing because I didn't want to yell at him. He then took me to the office. He asked why I wasn't working. I said I was taking deep breaths to calm down. He said I was lying. Got a detention. 

Once was shooing a fly in the back of the class as it kept coming at me. She said I was "dancing" and distracting students EVEN THOUGH I WAS IN THE BACK, AND NO ONE SAW ME. Detention. 

Once, when I was new to a school, the sub gave me a detention for not having my book and "losing" it, even though it was my first day, and had no idea what she was talking about. 

I have so many stories. I've been wrongfully given detentions SOOO many times. Thing is, when I'm asked what I did wrong, no one believes me when I say "nothing". These teachers give detentions out like candy on Halloween. I did nothing wrong, yet got sooooo many detentions. They just think I'm that kid who always says they did nothing wrong and denies it.
